points.point: Why the missing subtitle track error appears even though the video is public and plays
points.sentence: Blotato can only analyze TikToks that have a subtitle track.
Most TikTok videos have subtitle tracks, so try a different video.

verdict.reason: The entry explains that Blotato can only analyze TikToks with a subtitle track, which is why a public video that plays fine can still fail, and it suggests trying a different video.
